name: Symbiogenesis
source:
Lily is convinced that she's died and the only person who can fix her is a strange woman with an affinity for plants.

Only to repair something dissassembly is usually required.

[From [url=https://searedbread.itch.io/symbiogenesis]Itch.io[/url]]
